faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based research positions located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under the research project titled 'DESIGN OF 100+ GBPS OPTICAL TRANSCEIVERS FOR ONBOARD AND INTER SATELLITE COMMUNICATION'.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application online for IIT Roorkee Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 is 11-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or stipend offered for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess two years of research experience along with a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Roorkee SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the Google Forms link provided in the official notification before the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview which may be conducted online.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official apply link?
faq.answer: You can find the direct online application link in the Important Links section of this article as well as in the official notification released by IIT Roorkee.
